captions.text: Coere for Teams builds one memory of the company, its people and its clients.
The first run asks for the company once, with its clients.
Maya pastes the first clients, each with its website.
Then the AIs she uses at work, and Save.
Extract all saves every chat from each AI.
Cori asks what to build the company's memory from.
The graph grows into Company and Clients as Coere reads the chats.
The memory is ready.
All shows Company and Clients around Maya, beside her own sections.
Company holds the agency: its people, its way of working and its tools.
Clients has a folder for each client, with its contacts and promises.
Opened, Kestrel Outdoor draws its slots, and its sheet lists what sits in each.
A contact at Kestrel Outdoor starts with how to reach her, her role and her client.
A client the chats found waits in Review until Maya keeps it.
Maya asks Cori what the team promised Kestrel Outdoor.
Cori answers from memory, with each promise, its date and the AI it came from.
The first time she opens an AI, Cori shows how to call him: Right Option.
A tap brings out his chat, and the card is gone for good.
On ChatGPT, Maya starts a reply to Kestrel Outdoor.
The blue line names the client the draft is about. One client goes with each send.
The Enterprise card holds the company, its people and its clients.
To hand Kestrel Outdoor to a teammate, Maya exports that one client.
The line says what the file holds before she saves it.
When the work with Halvorsen Freight ends, Maya deletes everything about it.
The graph lights all of it, and the sheet says what goes.
Then Coere checks that nothing about it is left.
Coere for Teams: one memory of the company and its clients.
